# CitedBy

> CitedBy is a website audit for search in the age of ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI answers. Enter a URL: CitedBy crawls your site up to your plan's page limit, checks it against a list of checks (AI-crawler access, readable content, llms.txt, schema, titles and headings, internal links) and gives a graded report with a ready-to-paste fix for each issue. Plans: Single audit 9 EUR once (1 site, up to 500 pages), Starter 19 EUR/month (1 site, up to 1,000 pages, 10 crawls per 30 days), Pro 49 EUR/month (5 sites, up to 5,000 pages per site, 160 crawls per 30 days), Agency 99 EUR/month (25 sites, up to 10,000 pages per crawl, 800 crawls per 30 days); monthly plans start with a 7-day free trial (during the trial: 1 site, up to 500 pages, 2 audits); 14-day money-back guarantee. Service from Spain. Not citedby.co or citedby.ai (different companies); the only domain is citedby.eu.

## Pages
- [Home, checks, pricing and FAQ](https://citedby.eu/)
- [Free CI check for AI crawlers](https://citedby.eu/ci): a shell script and GitHub Action that fail a deploy when GPTBot, ClaudeBot or PerplexityBot see an empty or blocked page
- [citedby-check on GitHub](https://github.com/resaleiq/citedby-check): open-source command-line tool and GitHub Action (MIT) that run the free AI-search readiness check: robots.txt access for five AI-search crawlers, text in the raw HTML, Organization and Product data, llms.txt; exit codes for CI
- [AI crawlers: who they are and how to allow or block them](https://citedby.eu/bots): one page per crawler, vendor sentence and read date
- [AI crawler settings by platform](https://citedby.eu/platforms): Shopify, Squarespace, Wix, Webflow, WordPress.com and Cloudflare, each from the platform's own help page
- [AI-crawler access checker](https://citedby.eu/tools/ai-crawler-check): free, no account: robots.txt rules and a live request for GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Bingbot and Googlebot, with the exact fix
- [llms.txt checker](https://citedby.eu/tools/llms-txt-checker): free, no account: is /llms.txt present, valid, working and consistent with robots.txt and the sitemap
- [Findable check](https://citedby.eu/tools/findable-check): free, no account: can Google, Bing and the AI assistants' crawlers reach your site, is your sitemap declared, and the next step per engine
- [AI-crawler check badge](https://citedby.eu/badge): free with attribution: after the AI-crawler check, a small SVG badge for your own site that states how many of the 8 crawlers were allowed and the check date, with the one-line HTML snippet
- [Guides and articles](https://citedby.eu/blog): how AI assistants find and read websites
- [Free AI visibility check](https://citedby.eu/free-ai-visibility-check): free, no account: we crawl up to 10 pages and show your score, AI crawler access and the 3 issues to fix first
- [AI visibility audit guide](https://citedby.eu/ai-visibility-audit): what such an audit checks
- [EU AI-Access Index](https://citedby.eu/data/ai-access-index): which AI crawlers 10,426 popular EU sites block in robots.txt, by country and CMS, with method and CSV
- [CitedBy MCP server](https://citedby.eu/mcp-server): add CitedBy to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or Codex, address citedby.eu/mcp: check a page, AI-crawler access, llms.txt and a domain's referring domains; free, no account, read-only
- [Backlink lookup](https://citedby.eu/backlinks): free, no account: the 20 strongest domains linking to a site, from Common Crawl's open web graph, with method and limits; also in French, German, Spanish and Dutch
- [Data by niche](https://citedby.eu/data/study-buyer-questions-claude): published study with method and CSV

- [How an audit works (methodology)](https://citedby.eu/methodology): what is crawled, checked and scored, and what we do not claim
- [Engine changes](https://citedby.eu/changes): dated changes from Google, Bing and Lighthouse, each read on the engine's own page, and whether CitedBy checks them
- [About CitedBy](https://citedby.eu/about): which CitedBy this is and who operates it
- [Full text of these pages](https://citedby.eu/llms-full.txt): the plain text of the key English pages in one file (optional)
